Address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract that is invoked through low-level calls.
Cached Uniswap/Pancake pair address computed at deployment.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated in transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances, mutated in approve/transferFrom.
Total token supply (1e27) used as an arithmetic base in list().
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router interface used for liquidity provision.
Hardcoded WETH address used to derive the pair address.
Base constructor that stores the bot protection contract address.
ApeHaven constructor: assigns tx.origin as owner, derives pair, and grants infinite allowances.
Modifier that performs an external low-level call to botProtection before executing the guarded body.
Payable transfer entrypoint that delegates to transferFrom.
Payable transferFrom guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
Payable approve that writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with bytes b.
Internal pure function that computes a pair address via keccak256 of the two tokens.
Owner-only listing function that mints balances, adds liquidity and calls botProtection again.
Caller-controlled address used in access checks and allowance bookkeeping.
Origin of the transaction, used as owner and to grant infinite allowances.
Block timestamp used to build the router deadline.
Arbitrary delegatecall in delegate() allowing execution of untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
Low-level .call to botProtection inside checkBots, executed before state changes.
Low-level .call to botProtection inside list(), executed after balance mutations.
External call to routerForUniswap.addLiquidityETH forwarding msg.value and a deadline.

edges.reason: BotProtected constructor writes the botProtection state variable from its argument.
ApeHaven constructor invokes the BotProtected base constructor.
tx.origin is read inside the ApeHaven constructor, making deployment origin a control input.
Constructor assigns owner = tx.origin, so privileged access depends on the transaction origin.
tx.origin flows directly into the owner privileged state variable.
Constructor stores the pair derived from wrappedEther and this contract.
Constructor writes infinite allowances for itself, the router and tx.origin.
Constructor calls pairForPancake to compute uniPair.
msg.sender is used as the source of transfer().
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared against _from for the allowance branch in transferFrom.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier which makes an external call before any state update.
transfer inherits checkBots, so the low-level botProtection call executes before the transfer logic.
checkBots performs a raw low-level call to the untrusted botProtection contract.
botProtection can re-enter transferFrom through the external call made before balances are updated.
botProtection can re-enter transfer while the checkBots guard is still executing.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
balanceOf and allowance are mutated with raw -= operators without SafeMath.
The unchecked arithmetic writes directly into the balanceOf state mapping.
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and _spender.
delegate() gates the arbitrary delegatecall only on msg.sender == owner.
delegate() executes a user-supplied delegatecall to address a with calldata b.
list() calls the external Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with msg.value.
block.timestamp is used to compute the router deadline inside list().
block.timestamp + 600 is passed as the external router deadline.
list() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
list() makes a second low-level botProtection call after mutating balances.
The low-level botProtection call in list() can re-enter while balances have just been rewritten.
list() overwrites balanceOf for the contract, msg.sender and each _toAddresses entry.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 is computed and assigned to a balance inside list().
list() uses the routerForUniswap state variable for the liquidity call.

normalization_plan.reason: _from only exists as the source address argument of transferFrom and drives its balance/allowance logic.
_to is only the recipient argument of transferFrom and is written into balanceOf inside it.
_value is only the amount argument of transferFrom and feeds its unchecked arithmetic.
a is only the delegatecall target parameter consumed by delegate().
b is only the calldata parameter of the delegatecall inside delegate().
_botProtection is only the constructor argument stored into the botProtection state variable.
_numList is only the liquidity/balance amount parameter used by list().
_toAddresses is only iterated inside list() to write balances and emit Transfer.
_amounts is only indexed inside list() to assign recipient balances.
notABot/isNotBot are the return values of the low-level botProtection call in the checkBots modifier.
pair is the computed return value of pairForPancake and has no independent semantics.
token0/token1 are ordering temporaries used solely to hash the pair in pairForPancake.
i is only the loop counter of the distribution loop inside list().
